latestFormalFinding.boundary: R113 records a PARTIAL_RETURN visibility pattern under the declared reversed memory-access intervention. The verified matched-parent control shows that, with task and intervention held constant, changing the formal parent changes provenance but not participant/silent selection under the formal v0.9 baseline. Therefore PARTIAL_RETURN is a descriptive return-pattern measurement, not evidence of visibility path dependence in the current deterministic formal rule.

latestExperimentalControl.boundary: Isolated counterfactual executor only. It deliberately includes parent round ordinal in participant selection and has been CI-verified against R111 and R112. It does not write or advance formal greenhouse history and is engineering evidence that NOSTROMO can execute and audit a parent-sensitive transition, not evidence that the real SHROOMING population is causally path-dependent.

shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement are executable. RUN_READING_ROUND remains the verified parent-invariant v0.9 formal baseline and is chainable from a declared formal parent. The verified R111→R112→R113 chain preserves provenance and legacy R111 reproducibility. An isolated parent-sensitive counterfactual executor is now also verified; it deliberately makes participant selection depend on parent round ordinal but never mutates formal greenhouse history. Neither branch represents ten independently persistent live LLM processes, and the experimental branch must not be presented as evidence of real path dependence.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are closed-loop executable. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. FALSIFY executes a repository-scoped counterevidence probe using caller-declared contradiction markers and scope; absence is never upgraded to truth. Exhaustive private/internal mining remains unavailable.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY now executes a deterministic claim verdict over an explicit connector-supplied evidence bundle and returns SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or INDETERMINATE with provenance fingerprints. It does not search the web by itself and absence of refutation is not global truth.
